source_title: Congo to audit major miners annually from 2027 as part of local content drive, regulator says
quote: Democratic Republic of Congo will subject major mining companies to annual audits of subcontracting practices and compliance with local-content requirements from 2027, as authorities step up efforts to increase business for Congolese-owned firms, the head of the country's subcontracting regulator told Reuters.

source_title: Congo to audit major miners annually from 2027 as part of local content drive, regulator says
quote: A new local-content law is due to take effect on January 1, 2027.

source_title: Congo to audit major miners annually from 2027 as part of local content drive, regulator says
quote: ARSP this month ordered Glencore, Ivanhoe's Kipushi zinc mine and Chinese-controlled copper miner Sicomines to end non-compliant subcontracting arrangements, submit corrective plans and expand opportunities for Congolese-owned suppliers.
